messages:
Ellie: Quick sync: finalizing the Orbit ref-kit for cloud marketplace. Deliverables: terraform module, minimal example, CI smoke, listing metadata, two diagrams. Goal: internal alpha next week.
Ben: i'll take the terraform module skeleton + examples/basic and examples/complete. will follow module best-practices.
Rita: i'll own the architecture doc and diagrams (logical + ops), and a short quickstart with 3 cmds.
Kevin: i'll wire the GH Actions smoke job and add a small matrix for x86/arm. suggest running `terraform init` + `validate` in CI.
Ellie: constraints: screenshots must be scrubbed, 64x64 icon, 200-char listing blurb, include OSS license. also note TF version >=1.5.
Ben: adding `required_version = ">= 1.5"` and a providers block in README. examples will include a minimal datadog hook.
Rita: diagrams: will attach PNG + mermaid source; will include a short observability checklist (SLOs, KV cache hit, disk IO watch).
Kevin: CI snippet I'll add:
```
name: tf-smoke
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        arch: [x86, arm]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v2
      - run: terraform init -input=false
      - run: terraform validate
```
Ellie: please add pre-commit with `terraform fmt` and `tflint`. we want consistent style before merge.
Ben: ok will add .pre-commit-config and a `fmt -check` GH step.
Rita: timeline: today owners set. Tue PRs for module + docs. Wed CI finishes. Thu assets + metadata. Fri internal publish to partner staging.
Kevin: i'll schedule the staging validation window Friday morning and tag partner ops.
partner-bot: NOTE: when you upload packaging assets to /partner-artifacts, run `./tools/market-validate.sh` to auto-check metadata.
Ellie: thanks. who signs off alpha verification? need one person.
Kevin: i'll do the sign-off if CI passes and staging smoke is green.
Ellie: great. i'll open the tracker and link PRs. :thumbsup:
